# Roma City Tour

> > Official hop-on-hop-off bus tour service for Rome, featuring routes to major attractions including the Colosseo, Vatican, Fontana di Trevi, and Foro Romano.

Roma City Tour is operated by Carrani in partnership with Gray Line, offering panoramic bus tours with multiple routes and stops throughout Rome's historic center. The service includes mobile apps for iOS and Android with real-time tracking, multilingual audio guides, and flexible ticket options for exploring Rome's monuments, museums, and landmarks.

## Key Topics

- Hop-on-hop-off bus service
- Rome sightseeing tours
- Colosseo (Coliseum)
- Vatican City & Sistine Chapel
- Piazza Venezia & Foro Romano
- Fontana di Trevi
- Trastevere neighborhood
- Galleria Borghese
- Circo Máximo
- Ara Pacis
- Palazzo Venezia
- Bus route maps & schedules
- Tourist attractions & monuments
- Museum guides
- Mobile app tracking

- [Cosa vedere a Roma? | Hop On Hop Off Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/it/cosa-vedere): What to see in Rome: Colosseo, Vatican Museums, Pantheon attraction guide

## Bus Routes

- [Trip planner city tour | Rome City Tour | 10% Off Buying Online](https://roma.city-tour.com/en/routes/route-essential-rome): Essential Rome panoramic bus route from Largo Peretti/Termini
- [Route Rome Essentielle](https://roma.city-tour.com/fr/itineraires/route-rome-essentielle): Essential Rome panoramic route starting from Largo Peretti/Termini

## Bus Stops & Attractions

- [Città del Vaticano e Cappella Sistina](https://roma.city-tour.com/en/stops/Citta-del-Vaticano-e-Cappella-Sistina): Bus stop at Vatican City and Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's Square area
- [Piazza Venezia - Foro Romano](https://roma.city-tour.com/fr/arrets/Piazza-Venezia-Foro-Romano): Bus stop at Piazza Venezia near Foro Romano and Capitole
- [Piazza Venezia - Foro Romano](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/paradas/Piazza-Venezia-Foro-Romano): Bus stop at Piazza Venezia near Foro Romano and imperial forums
- [Santa Maria Maggiore](https://roma.city-tour.com/fr/arrets/Santa-Maria-Maggiore): Bus stop at Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore, Piazza dell'Esquilino

## Travel Guides & Planning

- [Planifica tu visita a Roma con Roma City Tour - Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/blog/planifica-tu-visita-a-roma-con-roma-city-tour): Rome trip planning guide: Colosseo, Fontana di Trevi, Bocca della Verità
- [Villa Borghese: Art and Nature - Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/en/blog/villa-borghese-art-and-nature): Villa Borghese park guide with Galleria Borghese, Bernini & Caravaggio art
- [Circo Máximo: revive las carreras de cuadrigas | Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/blog/circo-maximo-de-roma-camina-por-la-historia-y-revive-las-carreras-de-cuadrigas): Circo Máximo history guide: chariot races between Monte Aventino & Palatino
- [Palazzo Venezia: una joya escondida | Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/blog/la-roma-menos-turistica-descubre-el-palazzo-venezia): Palazzo Venezia hidden gem at Piazza Venezia with Renaissance architecture
- [Conoce las Termas de Caracalla - Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/blog/termas-de-caracalla): Termas de Caracalla visitor guide: Roman baths history and architecture

## Optional

- [Andy Warhol en el Complesso del Vittoriano - Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/blog/andy-warhol-en-el-complesso-del-vittoriano): Andy Warhol Pop Art exhibition at Complesso del Vittoriano in Rome
- [La guardia suiza pontificada - Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/blog/la-guardia-suiza-pontificia): Vatican Swiss Guard history, uniforms, and papal security role
- [Bocca della verita - Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/blog/bocca-della-verita): Bocca della Verità legend & Roman Holiday film location at Santa Maria
- [Summer is art - Roma City Tour](https://roma.city-tour.com/es/blog/summer-is-art): Summer is Art exhibition at Borgo Arte Gallery with international artists
